mapper.select: select a.id as apply_id, a.repair_no, a.fault_type, a.fault_desc, a.urgent_level, a.apply_time from eoms_repair_apply a where a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and a.del_flag='0' and a.apply_time <= #{cutoff} and a.status in ('WAIT','CONFIRM','ORDER') and not exists (select 1 from eoms_repair_order o where o.apply_id=a.id and o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and o.del_flag='0' and (o.status != 'WAIT_ACCEPT' or o.accept_time is not null)) and (a.status != 'ORDER' or exists (select 1 from eoms_repair_order o where o.apply_id=a.id and o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and o.del_flag='0' and o.status='WAIT_ACCEPT' and o.accept_time is null)) order by a.apply_time asc, a.id asc
select * from eoms_repair_apply where id=#{id} and tenant_id=#{tenantId} and del_flag='0' for update
select * from eoms_repair_order where apply_id=#{applyId} and tenant_id=#{tenantId} and del_flag='0' order by id for update
mapper.update: update eoms_repair_apply set status='ORDER',update_by=#{actor},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id=#{id} and tenant_id=#{tenantId} and del_flag='0' and status=#{expected}
